full_credit_requirements: Return True exactly when the ransom-note string can be constructed from the magazine string.
Use each occurrence of a magazine letter at most once, so every letter's multiplicity in the ransom note must not exceed its multiplicity in the magazine.
not_specified: No partial-credit or reward policy is specified.

evidence.quote: return True if you can construct the ransom note using the letters in the magazine, and False otherwise.
Each letter in the magazine string can only be used once in your ransom note.
